title: Black Friday Gets a Magenta Makeover with More Deals from T‑Mobile on the Latest Phones, Accessories and More
summary: From holiday wish lists to everyday connectivity, T‑Mobile has savings for everyone across T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile and T‑Mobile for Business — all on America's Best Network
body_markdown:
**BELLEVUE, Wash.** **— Nov. 24, 2026** — Black Friday deals are here early! T‑Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) is rolling out[more deals](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/offers/t-mobile-brings-more-to-the-holiday-mix) across T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile and T‑Mobile for Business. From the latest smartphones and wearables to accessories, customers can unwrap over $1,000 in savings on devices from Samsung, Google, Motorola and more — all on[America’s Best Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network?INTNAV=tNav%3ACoverage%3ANetwork) . And the savings don’t stop there. Starting Dec. 1, T‑Mobile is launching[12 Days of Magenta](https://www.t-mobile.com/brand/12-days-of-magenta) , bringing customers exclusive daily accessory deals in the[T-Life app](https://www.t-mobile.com/apps?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) .


T‑Mobile is bringing customers a brand-new way to save with 12 Days of Magenta, featuring exclusive daily accessory deals just for T‑Mobile customers. With T-Mix, customers can make their mix their own from the widest range of benefits in wireless across device promotions, streaming, music, travel, AI assistants, same-day delivery, gaming and more. Samsung Galaxy S26+ on Us (or up to $1,200 off eligible Samsung devices) when trading in an eligible device OR when activating a new line on Experience Beyond or a T-Mix plan with 3 Picks. Google Pixel 11 Pro on Us (or up to $1,100 off eligible Google devices) when trading in an eligible device OR when activating a new line on Experience More/Experience Beyond or a T-Mix plan with 2 Picks. Samsung Galaxy A37 5G on Us when bringing a number to Metro and joining the $40 Period plan — a $450 value!


## 12 Days of Magenta Accessory Deals


T‑Mobile is bringing customers a brand-new way to save with[12 Days of Magenta](https://www.t-mobile.com/brand/12-days-of-magenta) , featuring exclusive daily accessory deals just for T‑Mobile customers. Running Dec. 1–12 in the[T-Life app](https://www.t-mobile.com/apps?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) , customers can unwrap a new deal every day, with some of the biggest savings on accessories this year across charging, protection, gaming, audio and more — just in time for the holidays.

## There’s More to Life with Magenta


The best part of being with T‑Mobile? The value goes way beyond wireless. With all-new[T-Mix plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/xbox-game-pass?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPTMIXRC_92N82X2320555F3076273) , customers get more choice and flexibility, so that customers can choose the benefits they want and switch things up as their needs evolve. Customers can make their mix their own from the widest range of benefits in wireless across device promotions, streaming, music, travel, AI assistants, same-day delivery, gaming and more — including[XBOX Game Pass](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/xbox-game-pass?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPTMIXRC_92N82X2320555F3076273) and[Netflix](https://www.t-mobile.com/tv-streaming/netflix-on-us?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPTMIXRC_27R9948046G229285A756) to[DashPass by DoorDash](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/doordash?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPTMIXRC_4CP240118S63344896656) and[Delta miles](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel/delta-air-lines?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPTMIXRC_7O6225G184390923I5224) . Plus, with the[T‑Mobile Visa](https://www.t-mobile.com/cards/visa-credit-rewards?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) , cardholders can earn rewards on everyday purchases, from holiday gifts to groceries. And that’s on top of the perks T‑Mobile customers already know and love, including weekly deals and freebies with[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays) ,[exclusive travel benefits](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel) ,[premium experiences at events nationwide](https://www.t-mobiletickets.com/) and[more](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits) .
